correctness.rationale: For each four-vertex closed neighborhood unique among two colors is equivalent to odd red count. Outer equations determine inner assignments; substituting into inner equations gives homogeneous operator h_k(T), whose kernel dimension over F2 modulo T^n+1 is exactly degree gcd. Proof of this dimension does not rely on squarefree factorization. Explicit h_1=(t+1)^4 and h_2=(t+1)(t^5+1) lead to all stated residue cases; the five-periodicity closure argument is complete. Independent direct enumeration of all binary assignments n=3..8, reduced enumeration n=3..17, and exact polynomial gcd computations are supplied.

value.rationale: Generalized Petersen graphs form a canonical two-parameter family of cubic graphs. The just-published four-colour necessity result makes precise low-colour enumeration a timely structural question. The new exact gcd formula counts all named 2-colour assignments for the entire family, and the k=2 five-divisibility jump (2/4 versus 32/64) has a complete difference-word classification. This is more informative than a generic graph-colorability observation or a computation on a few finite graphs.
